lessons: In tests/test_reliability_battery.py near line 194, restore the real audit_journal before the supplied success/auditor verdict case. Otherwise the monkeypatched violations make _observe red no matter what the verdict says.

Pair the supplied success/auditor verdict with evidence that would otherwise be refused, such as the member journal with one required fault event removed. Assert BatteryRefused or red, so a regression that trusts the verdict fails the test.

Keep each refusal case isolated: missing, contradictory, cross-member and supplied-verdict evidence. Each must be the only defect in its fixture, so the assertion depends on that one refusal path (ticket: these must refuse green).
Change only the test case the review flagged. Leave the machinery, registration, writer and command as they are, since review found them correct, and rerun the four-suite Verification command.
